categories.main_business_segments: Hong Pu Real Estate Development primarily engages in the development, sale, and leasing of residential buildings, commercial buildings, and industrial properties. The company also involves in interior decoration, landscape engineering, retail of daily goods, and restaurant operations. Its core business focuses on residential elevator buildings and factory-office buildings, mainly serving the domestic market in Taiwan.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction techniques including seismic resistance, aluminum formwork, and curtain wall installation. It integrates computer-aided design systems for architectural planning and emphasizes quality control, cost management, and construction progress monitoring. The firm also invests in green building technologies and smart home features to enhance product uniqueness and sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hong Pu serves individual homebuyers, long-term property investors, and commercial tenants primarily within Taiwan. Its market focus is on residential buyers with rigid self-use demand and long-term asset holders, especially in the Taipei metropolitan area and other growth potential regions. The company’s leasing business targets commercial tenants for office buildings and hotels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, with a concentration in Taipei City, New Taipei City, Taoyuan, and other promising urban areas. It selects land parcels with convenient transportation and complete living functions, focusing on the Greater Taipei and Taoyuan metropolitan regions as core markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hong Pu operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain. It acquires land through development or joint construction, commissions construction contractors for building projects, and handles sales and leasing activities directly. The company does not engage in upstream raw material production but manages relationships with construction suppliers and contractors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes steady growth, operational efficiency, and cost control. It focuses on acquiring competitive land, accurate product positioning, and maintaining high construction quality. R&D efforts emphasize green building, smart housing, and innovative construction methods to meet evolving customer needs and regulatory requirements. Hong Pu also plans to develop long-term income-generating assets to enhance financial stability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale and leasing of residential and commercial properties. The company recognizes income from completed housing projects, pre-sale completions, and rental income from investment properties such as hotels and office buildings. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but on property transactions and rental cash flows.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hong Pu competes in Taiwan’s real estate development sector, focusing on differentiated projects by location and product features. Competition is less direct due to market segmentation by project and geographic area. The company leverages its brand reputation, land development capabilities, and financial strength to maintain a competitive position in the Greater Taipei and Taoyuan markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hong Pu reported net revenue of approximately NT$2.45 billion, a decrease from the previous year’s NT$3.23 billion, reflecting a market cooling. Pre-tax profit was about NT$210 million, down from NT$243 million. The company’s total assets stood at around NT$44.77 billion with equity of NT$12.4 billion, showing moderate growth. Earnings per share were NT$0.61, slightly down from NT$0.69 the prior year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hong Pu emphasizes high-quality construction, precise product positioning, and innovative design tailored to customer needs. It offers comprehensive services including full-cycle development, leasing, and sales, supported by strong financial management and brand reputation. The company’s focus on green building certifications and smart home features differentiates its products in the competitive Taiwanese real estate market.
